'''Veneziano Haas''' was a representative of [[Nirama]], a crime lord in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a skilled negotiator and an accomplished [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Despite his well-dressed appearance, he was considered a scoundrel. Haas was sent by the officials of Nirama to find [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and unaffiliated spacers during the [[Blockade of the Cularin system]] by the [[Thaereian military]]. The recruits were used to run the blockade and deliver needed medical supplies and foodstuffs.
